name: overnight-missed-every-night
about: An overnight run no runner can take gets a note in #loop on every night it misses, and says why (#416). The approver schedules tonight's run; the only runner asks for regression runs but has no voice capability (the overnight suite needs emulator, gpu, voice), so the run is never claimed and carries over. At 07:00 #loop says no runner takes it, naming what the runner offers; the next night's 07:00 says it again. Each missed night is a regression_missed event.

messages.text: ^\*Overnight regression R1 has not started\* \(set for 01:00 on Fri Oct 16\): no runner takes it: it needs one that claims regression runs and has emulator, gpu, voice \(seen: \S+ has emulator, gpu and takes regression\); the queue is busy: .+\.$
